tickets.summary: K-3401 main gas export compressor non-drive end bearing vibration has risen from 2.1 to 4.6 mm/s in six weeks, with growing 1x and sidebands, not plateaued. Single train, no spare: a trip means recycle and lost production within the hour.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: Finding says 'the trend is clearly upward and it has not plateaued'; vibration more than doubled (2.1 to 4.6 mm/s) in six weeks. Not at alarm yet and no confirmed failure, so short of the top of the range.

Not a Safety Critical Element and the consequence is production loss/recycle, not a major accident, so scored below the maximum. A bearing failure could also cause secondary machine damage, extending outage.

tickets.recommended_action: Request same-day rotating equipment specialist review of the NDE bearing spectrum (1x and sidebands). Increase monitoring frequency, set interim alarm/trip limits, and plan bearing inspection/repair at the earliest outage window if the trend continues.
